system.description:
A catch-all name for sedatives, used medically and as non-lethal Needle weapon rounds for hunting or self-defence; very tough targets may shrug it off.

A dosed target suffers one fatigue level, then must pass a Constitution test at TN 15 or suffer 1d10 further levels of fatigue. This fatigue recovers normally.
system.effectText: 1 fatigue and Con TN 15; failure adds 1d10 more fatigue.
